notes.title: "Angry Boy" has been released.
notes.content:
Hello.
This is Momentum Games.

I'm greeting you again to tell you good news today.

Just this update has added sound effects to every mellow scene!

In the meantime, you felt a little empty because there was no sound effect in the mellow scene?
If so, I think if you take this opportunity to connect again, you will be able to enjoy a more immersive scene than before!

Additionally, for smooth play, the conversation skip function has been added, and some elements that interfere with viewing have been modified.

I hope you have a happy day today and thank you for enjoying "Angry Boy".

notes.title: "Angry Boy" has been released.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031989/5fd89014c9da5f0b5868c7d551fdcdadfbe230ff.png[/img]

Hello,

We are pleased to share some exciting news with you today.

Our long-awaited game, Angry Boy, has finally been released!

This is the story of the demonic subjugation of a warrior who fell into this world during happy times with five of the new works of Momentum Games.

What do you think it would be like if you suddenly fell into this world while having a happy time?

Getting a huge boost to save this world's crisis and marry a princess?

However, the world does not go its way. During Happy Time, the hero of the story is summoned to the world and dies unjustly, 
and he hears an absurd sound that he must subdue the evil king to return him to the original world.

A hero who was forced to go on a journey and his watchman and guide Made Envy.

Will they be able to conquer the demons safely?

To celebrate the release, we are offering a 10% discount, so we hope you'll download the game and enjoy it. We will return soon with updates and more exciting news.

Thank you.
The Momentum Games Team
